name: doubt-driven-development
title_zh: 每个关键决定先过一遍冷启动的对抗性评审
tagline_zh: 在陌生代码、生产环境或不可逆操作前，让一个不带记忆的评审者专挑你自信的漏洞。正确性优先时，比事后调试便宜得多。
tagline_en: Before prod, security-sensitive, or irreversible moves, a memoryless reviewer hunts flaws in your confidence.
desc_en: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.
why_zh: 不是找茬，是强制换脑：每次评审都从零上下文出发，专破你因熟悉而忽略的盲区，让错误死在提交前。
why_en: Not nitpicking—forced perspective reset. Each review starts blank, targeting blind spots born from familiarity, killing bugs.
limit_zh: 只对非平凡决策生效，琐碎改动会拖慢节奏；需要你主动调用，不会自动触发；评审产出的是质疑清单，不负责修复或验证。
limit_en: Only for non-trivial decisions; trivial edits slow down. Manual invocation only. Outputs a challenge list, not fixes or verification—pair with tests.
title_en: Adversarial fresh-context review before every key decision
unshelf_reason: 2026-09-04 编辑判：前端工程师的 agent 工具三件，英文开发工具链（冷在读者身上）
